Name: Adding 13 new recipes
Author: CyberZat
Description:
[b][size=5]What will you find in this mod?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Add 13 new recipes that you can find from various sources.
[url=https://ibb.co/zZp9fvN][img]https://i.ibb.co/m4kZzWS/2024-04-28-12-50-41.png[/img]

[/url][*]Unique responses from some villagers upon receiving these new dishes.
[url=https://ibb.co/N38bjrh][img]https://i.ibb.co/vB7RPh5/2024-04-28-12-05-44.png[/img]
[/url][/list]
[b][size=5]Recipes
[/size][/b][i][size=3]Fruit Punch
[/size][/i]Ingredients: Fruit (Any) x3.
How to obtain: 
[spoiler]After you reach Level 7 in Foraging.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]
[size=3][i]Mushroom Soup
[/i][/size]Ingredients: Common Mushroom, Garlic, Wheat Flour, Milk (Any).
How to obtain:
[spoiler]Learn from the Cookbook or buy from the Saloon after year 1.[/spoiler]
[size=3][i]Ratatouille
[/i][/size]Ingredients: Oil, Eggplant, Summer Squash, Tomato.
How to obtain: 
[spoiler]Sent to your mailbox after you reached 10-Heart with Lewis.[/spoiler]
[i][size=3]Fugu
[/size][/i]Ingredients: Pufferfish.How to obtain: 
[spoiler]Sent to your mailbox after you reached 10-Heart with Willy.[/spoiler]
[i][size=3]Honey Peach Frappe
[/size][/i]Ingredients: Peach, Honey, Milk (Any).
How to obtain:
[spoiler]Learn from the Cookbook or buy from the Saloon after you've obtained 'Cook' achievement [i](cook 10 different recipes)[/i].[/spoiler]

[i][size=3]Bubble Milk Tea[/size][/i]
Ingredients: Milk (Any), Tea Leave, Sugar x2.
How to obtain:
[spoiler]Learn from the Cookbook or buy from the Saloon after year 1.[/spoiler]

[i][size=3]Shrimp Fried Rice[/size][/i]
Ingredients: Egg (Any), Rice, Shrimp, Spring Onion.
How to obtain:
[spoiler]Sent to your mailbox after you reached 10-Heart with Jodi.[/spoiler]
[i][size=3]Mixed Fruit Smoothie[/size][/i]
Ingredients: Strawberry, Blueberry, Cransberry, Blackberry.
How to obtain:
[spoiler]Learn from the Cookbook or buy from the Saloon after you've obtained 'Cook' achievement [i](cook 10 different recipes)[/i].[/spoiler]
[i][size=3]Curry Rice[/size][/i]
Ingredients: Rice, Carrot, Potato, Leek.
How to obtain:
[spoiler]Learn from the Cookbook or buy from the Saloon after you've obtained 'Cook' achievement [i](cook 10 different recipes)[/i].[/spoiler]
[i][size=3]Sangria[/size][/i]
Ingredients: Wine, Orange, Apple, Sugar.
How to obtain:
[spoiler]Learn from the Cookbook or buy from the Beach Resort.[/spoiler]
[i][size=3]Salmon Steak[/size][/i]
Ingredients: Salmon, Honey, Oil, Garlic.
How to obtain:
[spoiler]]Learn from the Cookbook or buy it from the Saloon after you've obtained the Sous Chef achievement [i](Cook 25 different recipes)[/i].[/spoiler]
[i][size=3]Baked Alaska[/size][/i]
Ingredients: Ice cream, Sugar, Wheat Flour, Egg (Any).
How to obtain:
[spoiler]Learn from the Cookbook or buy it from the Saloon after you've obtained the Sous Chef achievement [i](Cook 25 different recipes)[/i].[/spoiler]
[i][size=3]Beef Wellington[/size][/i]
Ingredients: Bug Steak, Wheat Flour, Egg (Any), Oil.
How to obtain:
[spoiler]]Learn from the Cookbook or buy it from the Saloon after you've obtained the Sous Chef achievement [i](Cook 25 different recipes)[/i].[/spoiler]
[/spoiler]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][size=2]
1. Have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] already installed.
2. Download my mod, and extract it into the Mods folder.
3. [i]Enjoy!

[/i][/size][size=5][b]Extension[/b][/size]
[size=3][i]Translation:[/i][/size]
If anyone wants to do a translation for my mod, please comment in the post first, and then I'll permit it.

[size=3][i]Suggestions:[/i][/size]
Please leave any suggestions you may have in the post tab, thank you :)

[i][size=3]Compatibility:[/size][/i]
Currently, there shouldn't be any issues regarding the new recipes/gift taste. So if anyone encounters any other issues, please let me know right away!

[b][size=5]Bugs[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]The fruit category's icon and description in the cooking menu don't work as it's hard-coded. Will try to fix it after I have free time to learn how to C# coding lol.
[/list]
